Details:
Two Deeds for Great St James Island purchased by GREAT ST JIM LLC in
January 2016, obtained from U.S. Virgin Islands Recorder of Deeds
database are attached hereto.

On January 18,2016, Parcels A, A-1 and A-2, were conveyed to GREAT ST
JIM LLC for consideration in the amount of $17,500,00.00.
On January 21, 2016, Parcels B-1, B-1-1, B-1-2, B-2, B-2-1, B-2-2, C1, C-1-1, C-1-2, C-2, C-2-1, C-2-2, were conveyed to GREAT ST JIM LLC for
consideration in the amount of $5,000,000.00.
